topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I open the front door to find a package that doesn’t belong to me. The address label has a name I don’t recognize, and it’s crossed out with a permanent marker, replaced with my own address. My hands fumble as I turn the box over, checking for any signs of what it might contain. I consider leaving it by the door, imagining the rightful owner will come looking. But what if it’s important? I glance around the room, wondering where to put it where it won’t get misplaced. I decide to set it aside and call the post office later, hoping they can figure out who it should go to. For now, I just want to get it out of my sight.
